programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Yorkshire Dales, England"
programme.desc: Imagine a 26-pub, 7-day, 60-mile pub-crawl! Doing a traditional ‘ramble’ through the stunning Yorkshire Dales region of northern England, the brother’s stride through the moors and dales and peaks and valleys - legs and livers intact.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Erg Chigagga, Sahara, Morocco"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Erg Chigagga, Sahara, Morocco
programme.desc: From Marrakesh, the brothers take a series of local Berber taxis over the High Atlas Mountains and down into the Draa Valley until the road ends at the edge of the great sand sea of the Sahara where they bury some treasure.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Season 1 “Best of”"
programme.desc: Jonathan is back in India to host a special episode which explores his vast archive of experiences throughout India. Jonathan also reveals an exclusive insight into the inner workings of the show, how everything is put together and behind the scenes.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Amsterdam to Morocco"
programme.desc: Jonathan starts off the season by exploring Dutch curiosities, and then hops on the world's largest cargo ship enroute for Morocco, where a whole new adventure starts

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Yerevan"
programme.desc: Josh goes local exploring in Armenia and its capital Yerevan, visiting some amazing abandoned Soviet buildings, a knitting factory and a luxurious hotel.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Gary, Indiana"
programme.desc: Josh is back in Gary, Indiana, for a local exploring adventure. With friends, he visits a former bank, the memorial auditorium and Union Train Station.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Beijing and beyond"
programme.desc: Ash has made it to Beijing, where he’s meeting Terry Townsend to learn more about wildlife conservation in the region around the Great Wall of China. He also meets two more Wall Protectors and samples local delicacies in Shi Xia Village.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S1 - "Kaimoana Feast"
programme.desc: After a demonstration from guest judge Gareth Stewart teams attempt to cook the perfect beef eye fillet. The final Throwdown challenge asks teams to create a kaimoana feast. Who will make it to the final?

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S1 - "The Final"
programme.desc: The two finalists face off in an epic battle of barbecue prowess. First, they must cook a banquet using a wood fire pit. Next, it’s time for the classic BBQ competition with beef brisket, ribs and chicken - all judged blind.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2 - "Two Dish Battle"
programme.desc: Six teams meet host Ganesh Raj and BBQ experts Jared Macdonald and Jess Pryles in Waiamuku to begin the ultimate barbecue battle. They are challenged to make two dishes that showcase their barbecue skills: one low ‘n slow and one hot ‘n fast.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Arviat, Nunavut, Canada"
programme.desc: Heading to the far north into the Arctic to learn about the Inuit’s traditional culture and incredible way of life, the brothers accompany an elder and young hunter on a 200-mile skidoo hunt across the barren land and frozen sea ice.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kushtia, Bangladesh"
programme.desc: The brothers traverse the country’s interconnecting network of waterways by ferryboat. From shrimp baron, to peasant fishermen, lofty temple ruins to anonymous chai wallahs, they make their way to Kushtia, home to the shrine of Guru Lalone Shaw.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Kingdom of Mustang, Nepal"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Kingdom of Mustang, Nepal
programme.desc: Securing special visas, the brothers get 10 ponies and 6 porters and undertake a stunning, but difficult 13-day pony trek over the Himalayas to the valley of Mustang where they will try to have a sitting with the king.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Mumbai"
programme.desc: Mumbai's rag to riches story is experienced in the entire spectrum; Bollywood roles, a stay at Taj Palace, and an indepth tour of Dharavi slums, oh and dont' forget a spot of rat hunting!

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Thailand"
programme.desc: Muay Thai, river festivals, tourist scams and mahouts! This is a look at Thailand the Road less Traveled way

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Indonesia"
programme.desc: Jonathan is exploring the fringes of Indonesia; black magicians, semi active volcanoes and sulphur spewing lakes!

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Stunning Scenario"
programme.desc: A day of gruelling grape picking lies ahead and the duo discover a new love for the country’s greatest export.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Back to where it all started"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Back to where it all started
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave are reaching the end of their incredible journey and must go back to where it all started Buenos Aires.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "6000 km"
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave make a toast to their recently finished trip rough riding across Argentina.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Zagreb"
programme.desc: Epic Exploring: Going Local visits Zagreb, Croatia. Cody fires a canon from the old tower, explores a never finished University Hospital and a political school.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Barentsburg"
programme.desc: Local Exploring on the edge of the world as Josh is on the artic Svalbard archipelago to explore in and around Barentsburg and the Arctic Ocean.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Tirana"
programme.desc: From Tirana, capital of old Soviet satellite Albania, Josh starts another local adventure filled with bunkers, a hidden hospital and diving in a pirate’s cave.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2 - "Kettle Barbecues"
programme.desc: The five returning teams go back to basics cooking poultry on classic kettle barbecues. Just when they think they have it all under control the judges throw them a surprise twist.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2 - "Smokers"
programme.desc: The remaining four teams are split into two for a team challenge cooking on two 500-gallon offset smokers. Guest judge Gareth Stewart challenges the losing teams to recreate a restaurant quality venison dish in the first Scorcher challenge.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2 - "Blast from the Past"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Blast from the Past
programme.desc: A blast from the past introduces a new team to the competition. Teams cook an Asian street food feast on hibachi grills, then two teams must prepare a classic French tarte tartin in the Scorcher challenge.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Iceberg Alley, Newfoundland, Canada"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Iceberg Alley, Newfoundland, Canada
programme.desc: Flying a bush plane to the far-reaching tip of the ‘Rock’, the brothers are back in the rugged, isolated island where they were born. Via kayak, the brothers paddle from fishing port to fishing port before reaching their ultimate destination.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "California"
programme.desc: Jonathan showcases what makes his state the best to enjoy all the outdoor activities; trackdayss, paragliding, swimming; the exploration at San Francisco and winds all the way down South to Los Angeles

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Philippines P1"
programme.desc: Back in Asia, Jonathan embarks on a walking tour to explore all the intricacies of Manila; a tour that ends up with meeting Manny Pacquiao!

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Philippines P2"
programme.desc: Jonathan tracks down cases of mysticism and locale lore; to contrast the macabre, he decides to host his own beauty pageant in the town of Iloilo

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Eagle's Neck"
programme.desc: In his toughest challenge so far, Ash takes on Eagle’s Neck – a notoriously steep and dangerous section of the Great Wall of China. But first, he meets tech experts who’ve been helping to digitally map The Great Wall in an effort to protect it.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Inner Mongolia"
programme.desc: Following the Great Wall west, Ash heads to Inner Mongolia to meet up with a nomadic family and to try Mongolian wrestling. He’s hoping to visit Naadam Festival, which features a key part of Mongolian culture: horseracing.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Lüderitz"
programme.desc: Epic Exploring is going local again as Cody adventures in Lüderitz, Namibia going off the beaten path, through the desert and on to the ghost town of Pamona.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Tokyo"
programme.desc: Local Exploring in Tokyo is like nothing else. Josh and Lexi Limitless visit the crowded streets, a screaming Monster Café and an abandoned ‘Love Hotel’.

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2 - "Semi Final"
programme.desc: Four teams face off in the semifinal. First, teams whip up a seafood feast to impress acclaimed chef Tom Hishon (Kingi, Orphans Kitchen, Daily Bread). Then the bottom two teams cook to save their bacon in the ultimate test of simplicity – cooking the perfect steak for a surprise guest judge. Who will make it to the final?

programme.title: Cooks on Fire S2 - "Final"
programme.desc: The three finalists cook off over two rounds. First, a live fire challenge where they must prepare a whole lamb asado style, next, a barbecue degustation to impress legendary chef Al Brown.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Lake Titicaca, Peru"
programme.desc: The brothers hitch-hike from the ancient Inca capitol of Cuzco, down the spine of the Andes Mountains to Lake Titicaca. They suffer acute mountain sickness, get high on coca leaves and meet some locals as they battle their way across the Andes.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Desert Survival"
programme.desc: Ash heads into the desert to meet up with Wu Xinlei, who is a survival expert. He’s hoping to understand what it would have been like for the people who built The Great Wall in this remote and punishing landscape.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Malaysia"
programme.desc: Jonathan chances upon a shoe-dating marketing campaign and heads out on 3 unique dates to explore KL. Later, he comes across a unique situation deep in Sarawak

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Vietnam"
programme.desc: Jonathan is pinballing around Hanoi, exploring fables, eating exotic foods, and helping MAG international remove unexploded ordinance

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Japan"
programme.desc: In the world’s most populous city, Jonathan embarks on a quest to understand the new social dynamics of a modern society.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S2 - "Nikko"
programme.desc: Epic Exploring: Going Local is back in Japan in Nikko as Cody, reunited with Sherman Mak, explores a derelict onsen and an amusement park called Western Village.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Russia"
programme.desc: Jonathan faces his toughest challenge yet as he enters a country that has been coming to grips in defining and understanding their own cuisine. Through the historical turmoil and harsh climate, Russia has lost it’s traditional way of cooking, and eating. But the country is reviving this culture; Jonathan ventures the far stretches of the country to learn about modern cooks, as well as ancient kitchens housing the one key tool that gave birth to true Russian cuisine, the Russian oven. He’ll learn their insights, understand their efforts, and work with traditional Russian ingredients to learn what the cuisine used to be, and where it’s headed today.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Mexico"
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg is from California and he thinks he knows Mexican cuisine. This notion gets shattered as he experiences the onslaught of food in Mexico city! Between trying scorpion tacos and dodging shady markets in San Juan, he learns the dark art of sacred drinks, like pulque and mezcal, now turned into social libations. His journey also takes him to Oaxaca where he gets the low down on the fabled Mole sauce, and a long haul to a remote village reveals a secret ceremony that has origins of dark arts!

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Seychelles"
programme.desc: Sashi explores Seychelles’ beaches, octopus curry, and island-fresh seafood—from Mahe to remote Desroches—for a true taste of paradise.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Maldives / Soneva Jani"
programme.desc: At Soneva Jani, Sashi experiences ultra-luxury dining—from crab curry to surprise chef’s tables and sunset BBQs in the Maldives’ most iconic resort.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Mauritius Part 1"
programme.desc: Sashi explores Mauritius from street food to luxury resorts, tasting rum, meeting top chefs, and uncovering why this island is a rising global hotspot

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Crescent Lake"
programme.desc: Ash is into the final stretch of his journey along The Great Wall of China. After seeing the building techniques used on the Great Wall, Ash heads into the Gobi Desert to the stunning Cresent Lake – a beautiful oasis between walls of sand.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Mission Accomplished"
programme.desc: After meeting an old friend from the Chu Great Wall, Ash visits some beautiful stone structures – both natural and human-made – at Yardang National Park and Xiaofang City. With one final phone call home, it's time to leave The Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Japan P2"
programme.desc: During the Sengoku period Japan was the realm of warriors: Samurai, Ronin, Ninja. Jonathan looks to descend into the past by uncovering the little changed traditions of Bushido

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2 - "Season 2: Best Of"
programme.desc: A season’s worth of recap! Host Jonathan Legg recounts his best moments from the second season of Road Less Traveled, revealing unique insights from the destinations and releasing never before seen footage

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "Nevada"
programme.desc: Jonathan begins the journey from California with a rugged 4x4 cross of the Mojave desert, full of ghost towns and danger. Finally, making way for Las Vegas, where a whole new bag of adventures await.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Winnie Love"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 The Gift of Winnie Love
programme.desc: A dangerous drive to Ecuador leads to some tranquility next to an active volcano! He connects deeply with a woman over their love of dogs.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Connection"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 The Gift of Connection
programme.desc: Leon takes his chance at sand boarding in the dunes of Peru. In Lima he finds a man that shares his passion for connecting with travelers.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Knowledge"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 The Gift of Knowledge
programme.desc: On the way to Machu Pichu Leon meets a kindhearted fisherman. In Urubamba a visit to a friend and her school leaves him awestruck.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Re-live"
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave re-live some more of the highlights from their incredible 6000km journey.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Mauritius Part 2"
programme.desc: Sashi dives into Mauritius’ food scene—street eats, rum, top chefs, and luxury escapes—showing why this island is becoming a must-visit destination.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Kraalbaai Caribbean"
programme.desc: While Xander and his team experience the joys of wakeboarding in the beautiful Kraalbaai Caribbean, Adam attempts to replicate this experience.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "The Langeberg Mountains"
programme.desc: The South African crew travels to the Langeberg Mountains for a luxurious day of relaxation and exploration while Adam searches for wildlife on his makeshift Canadian safari.

programme.title: The Armchair Adventurer S1 - "Royalty in Robertson"
programme.desc: While Xander and his team experience the lush, green valleys and incredible vineyards in Robertson, Adam learns a tough lesson about not only surviving, but thriving.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "Cambodia"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores the concept of sustainable tourism in Cambodia; he embarks on a jungle patrol mission with Wildlife Alliance, showcasing the story of the illegal poaching and trading industry.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "India"
programme.desc: Jonathan begins a quest to find an extreme type of holy man reputed to eat human flesh and commit other blatant acts of embracing taboos in a strange path to nirvana.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "India Part 2"
programme.desc: In a country where anything can be found, Jonathan is unsurprising to find women in different roles and status, but the extremes are shockingly diverse and unexpected.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Travel"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 The Gift of Travel
programme.desc: Leon crosses Lake Titicaca heading to Bolivia as Kindness 2 breaks down again! A street musician reconnects him with his passion for travel.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S2 - "The Gift of Friendship"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 The Gift of Friendship
programme.desc: After arriving in Argentina Leon stays with a homeless family. He makes a splash bungee jumping and meets a Haitian student with a selfless heart.

programme.title: Beyond The Beaten Path S1 - "Luxor, Egypt"
programme.desc: The brothers chosen form of transport in Egypt is a Felucca Boat…the ancient trading vessel of transport. They travel north along the Nile, from the oasis town of Aswan to the ancient city of Luxor, before finding a massive sand dune to slide down.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "NARCOTRAFFIC POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: As one of the world’s top cocaine producers, Peru is a magnet for global drug cartels. To combat the trade at its source, the elite anti-narcotics unit Sinchi was formed—taking the fight deep into the heart of production zones.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "TOURIST POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: With one of the highest homicide rates in the world, Acapulco sees 104 murders per 100,000 people. In this deadly environment, a special anti-crime unit puts their lives on the line daily to keep the city from descending into chaos.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "EUROPEAN POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In the multicultural hubs of Paris and London, tensions can run high. It’s up to the police to bridge differences and keep the peace—working daily to protect some of Europe’s busiest capitals.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "River Rescue"
programme.desc: Region 1 Wardens come across a squatter on public land that leaves them speechless. And Region 5 Wardens are on high alert at the annual Yellowstone River Boat Float.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S2 - "After The Fall"
programme.desc: A rock-climbing disaster hurtles climber Craig DeMartino 100 feet down a granite cliff. A shattered heap of broken bones, Craig clings to life. In a split second, Craig’s life becomes an inspiring fight to survive.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S2 - "A River's Grasp"
programme.desc: In an isolated mountain river, Fisherman Dean Ririe becomes hopelessly trapped under a boulder in water up to his neck. In icy waters that should kill a man, Dean fights for his life miles from help.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S2 - "Atv Nightmare"
programme.desc: A father and son camping trip turns into a desperate fight to survive when John Sloot is crushed under an ATV. Now his 10 year-old son, Cody must brave the wilderness alone to get help.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S3 - "Cast Away Panama"
programme.desc: The Darien Gap is a roadless crossing between Panama and Columbia that consists of dense rainforest, steep mountains and vast swamps, but Mario's interest lies in the depths of the Pacific Ocean offshore.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S3 - "Warrior to Warrior"
programme.desc: In Kenya, former UFC Champion Luke Rockhold faces up with the Maasal warriors and tests himself with Mario before going into the deep wilderness to discover a monster animal that both eludes them and then re-appears.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild S3 - "Edge of the Earth"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E10 Edge of the Earth
programme.desc: Go as far north as you can and once you're there go a little further. Mario finds himself in one of the most remote parts of the world exploring an unknown landscape. There's Reindeer, arctic char but will he come home with the food his looking for?

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Never Ending Day"
programme.desc: The Warden's day starts early with an opportunity to capture a convicted game violator who has dodged the law for over 3 years. But just as one case closes another begins - forcing them to work late into the night.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Angry Like a Moose"
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 Angry Like a Moose
programme.desc: Region 4 Wardens are called in to round up a 1000 pound bully. But this youngster is not leaving the safety of his home. The Wardens turn to drastic measures to secure the situation.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "River Rescue"
programme.desc: Region 1 Wardens come across a squatter on public land that leaves them speechless. And Region 5 Wardens are on high alert at the annual Yellowstone River Boat Float.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Rainy Lake"
programme.desc: Mark Melnyx is in Sunset Country on the hunt for Bass and Pike on the fly.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Libby's Camp"
programme.desc: Info not available

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Valley Fishing Guides"
programme.desc: Stillwater Expert Phil Rowley travels to Canada's West Coast on the hunt for trout.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "ATV Accidents"
programme.desc: ATVs have allowed us to penetrate the wilderness like never before. But they’ve also made the backcountry a bit more dangerous. Laura and Nick rig up some dramatic, high-speed tests to see how accidents happen and what you can do to protect yourself.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "WOMEN POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In Hyderabad, India, wealth and poverty coexist side by side. Each day, 15,000 officers battle crime ranging from theft to interreligious violence. In Palestine, 8,500 police face an even tougher challenge—working across a fragmented, politically tense landscape where every patrol carries risk.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "MEDITERRANEAN - HARBOUR POLICE PATROLS"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 MEDITERRANEAN - HARBOUR POLICE PATROLS
programme.desc: In Catalonia, the regional police have taken over from Spain’s national force, deploying a rapid-response motorcycle unit to tackle urban crime. Meanwhile in Haifa, Israel’s main port city, police operate under strict laws in a tense environment shaped by terrorism threats and ongoing regional conflict.

programme.title: Police Patrol S1 - "RIVER POLICE PATROLS"
programme.desc: In Brazil, the Paraná River is a major trafficking route—patrolled by NEPOM, a specialized river police unit. In Guayaquil, Ecuador, police join forces with local communities to combat all forms of trafficking on the ground.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Chamois"
programme.desc: This story is about the mountain, unspoiled nature, the hunt for silence, and some very agile goats.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "Become NatureWise"
programme.desc: The organization's mission is to develop children's nature identity and understanding of nature by disseminating nature, hunting, and angling, plus cooking from nature pantries of plants, fish, and wild game.

programme.title: The Urban Huntsman S1 - "The Tuscan Boar"
programme.desc: Discover a master knife maker, pursue wild boar in the hills, and experience the charm of an award-winning castle.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "White Death"
programme.desc: Snow, what the mountain men called white death, stops Laramy in his tracks. In addition, his trusty horse Seven has suffered a leg injury. Laramy must take care of Seven, battle through hunger, and survive the snowfall.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "The Struggle"
programme.desc: Laramy remains stuck at Camp Hell Hole, nursing 7's leg, and struggling to survive in the freezing temperatures without food.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "On the Move"
programme.desc: Laramy and 7 leave camp Hell Hole and hit the trail again. They are headed for lower elevation in search of a more permanent place to call home.

programme.title: Dropped S8 - "Bull Run"
programme.desc: Sunrise gives life to the valley and animals are on the move.

programme.title: Dropped S8 - "Stay or Go"
programme.desc: Miles upon miles remain in the trip, but should the brothers leave animals to find animals?

programme.title: Dropped S8 - "End of the Line"
programme.sub-title: S08 : E07 End of the Line
programme.desc: Alaska doesn't asks you to leave, she tells you to leave.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Failure To Tag"
programme.desc: Birds, bucks and missing licenses. This week the Wardens watch a clear violation take place in Region 5. Property lines are crossed in pursuit of upland game and a license check comes up empty.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Warden's Instinct"
programme.desc: There is often a fine line between false information and the truth. Veteran Region 5 wardens use their sixth to bring game violators to justice.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Fourth Dimension"
programme.desc: Fourth of July in Montana – Flathead Lake is where the party is at. But with the heat tempers flare and the free flowing alcohol combines to make a dangerous situation.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Bowmans Island Charters"
programme.desc: Hosts Mark Melnyk and Jack Imhof travel to Ontario's Sunset Country to find big trout.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Camp Grayling"
programme.desc: Jenna McKeown and Mikey Metcalfe team up in Saskatchewan to fish for the prized Arctic Grayling and some big pike.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Yellowstone Idaho"
programme.desc: Host Mark Melnyk continues his RV fishing Adventures in Idaho.

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2 - "Far North Bluewater Mission"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Far North Bluewater Mission
programme.desc: 60 nautical miles + 200kg of Burley divided by 3 keen spearos = mayhem. The team go wide this week, overnighting aboard The Orca in 1000m of water in the Far North, in an attempt to create a 24-hour trail capable of attracting in who knows what!

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2 - "Hardcore Hapuka"
programme.desc: We return to Fiordland in the hope of going one step better in slotting a hapuka on a spear, but the presence of Bluefin Tuna off the coast, and Wapiti Bulls on the slip faces proves a tempting distraction from the task at hand!

programme.desc: A prostitution sting leads police to uncover additional crimes. A prostitute tells deputies she wanted money to buy her daughter a birthday gift. Deputies are called to an assault at a pub.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers respond after a bloody man is seen prowling around an apartment complex. Officers pull over a suspicious vehicle. Police seize drugs and a large knife from a bicyclist.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S23 : E16 My Bills Won't Wait
programme.desc: A suspect calls the police and states that he wants to kill himself and any officer who tries to help him. None of the three occupants of a stopped car will admit to ownership of a bag of drugs. A man begs not to be arrested so that he can pay child support.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers attempt to detain undocumented people crosssing the border. Border patrol discovers a driver with a load of drugs in his car. Officers check passports and a suspicious-looking laptop.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S15 : E36 Don't Keep on Truckin
programme.desc: The occupants of a car with out-of-state plates try to conceal their identities. Officers investigate a vehicle lingering near a park known. An officer investigates a robbery at a truck stop.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A defiant suspect winds up on the wrong side of a K-9 bite. A former fiancé becomes a neighborhood nuisance when he pays his ex an unwanted visit. A routine traffic stop turns into warrants, pregnancy, and Meth.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S29 : E19 Between a Bush and a Hard Place
programme.desc: A high-speed car chase switches gears when the driver flees on foot. Tempers flare between neighbors after kids get physical. A nervous driver becomes irate after the police search his passenger.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Emotions run high during a dispute involving alcohol and a beloved pet. A motorist struggles to keep his story straight. Deputies respond to a domestic episode and find the suspect in an awkward spot.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S24 : E01 She Came Onto Me
programme.desc: An undercover police officer sets up a sting to buy drugs. Officers find a surprise in a suspect’s trunk. A man claims that a prostitute has kidnapped him.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A patrolman plays linebacker when a fleeing thief runs right into him. Armed-robbery victims give a colorful play-by-play on surveillance footage of the crime. Officers have to get tearful children back to their estranged mother.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A sleeping motorist greets deputies with a foul mood. The cops respond to reports of a suspicious person, only to uncover much more. A young woman tries to promise her way out of a trip to jail.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: The suspect of a carjacking tells an Officer that he would rather go to jail than face the wrath of his mother. An Officer investigates a domestic call involving a husband, wife and a lamp. A slow speed pursuit ensues and the suspects are booked for felony, eluding, and drugs.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: An officer is attacked while attempting to break up a fight. Officers confiscate marijuana during a routine traffic stop. A man is arrested for domestic abuse.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: A man runs from Police over a parole violation. Officers respond when a trouble maker is expelled from a bar for bad behavior. Police pursue a man after he bails from his car during a traffic stop.

programme.title: Cops
programme.sub-title: S22 : E12 The Car is Mine!
programme.desc: A man locks himself in a trunk after deputies respond to a restraining order call. Deputies respond to two women arguing over the ownership of a car. A driver comes clean to a deputy during a traffic stop.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Deputies confront an intoxicated man who threatened a restaurant owner. A man tells officers he can assault who he wants. Officers are called to an altercation over a sleeping bag and a backpack.

programme.title: Cops
programme.desc: Officers hold a man under a car at gunpoint after a traffic stop. Officers are flagged down and directed to a couple arguing on the street. A man apologizes to detectives for the illicit items they find.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Under pres for at opfylde deres købers stramme tidsfrist, kommer Robin og Josh op og toppes, da de støder på endeløse problemer med saven.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Da et større sammenbrud truer med at lukke minen, tager Claudia og Robin en risikofyldt beslutning for at få det desperat nødvendige brændstof hen til lejren.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK
programme.desc: Josh undgår med nød og næppe en katastrofe, da han kører ind i minen med brændstof, og Claudia bliver knust, da en jadesten flækker i to, mens hun skærer den.

programme.title: Jade Fever | DK

programme.desc: Follow Bill as he tours a medieval aristocrat's massive fortress that mirrors the Forbidden City. From giant burial mounds, to new Olympic sites, to still moving food, join Bill as he finds the soul of this modern ancient country.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Yap"
programme.desc: The craziest dive though is when he feeds dozens of sharks with no protective gear. Trying to top that on land, Bill makes a mind blowing deal with a local chief to film where no one has filmed before…The Forbidden Island.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Madagascar"
programme.desc: The real Madagascar has no talking lions, zebras or hippos. What it does have is the most unique collection of plants and animals anywhere on earth. Bill fights the nearly inaccessible land to find a rare lemur that dances and another one that sings.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Tasmania - Part 1"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong takes a ride on the Spirit of Tasmania to explore Northern Tasmania and tries hunting of a different kind, gets is hands dirty harvesting a local crop and gets an insight into cooking with a protein only available in Tasmania.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Tasmania - Part 2"

programme.desc: Jakarta, urban meets jungle. The yellow brick road, shiny shoes at Survive Skate shop, 24/7 under the bridge. Road trip to Bandung, a mosque session, Nasi Padang Every Day, Bhang records, live with Sigit, motion graphics and self-expression.

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Bali"
programme.desc: Bali, the paradise island of magic. It's about progression at Motion Skate Park, DIY at the Jungle spot, vegan indulgence at Kynd café, design for the Hand of God, hot bowl grinds at the Dog Bowl and Loco by Nature and Televisi Star worldwide.

programme.title: Rhys Darby in Japan S1 - "The Masters"
programme.desc: Rhys learns what makes Japanese audiences tick from a pair of comedy masters, and he puts on a comedy show of his own. Also, New Zealand's mascot Pabu-chan is finally revealed to the world.

programme.title: Rhys Darby in Japan S1 - "The Rise of Pabu-chan"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Rise of Pabu-chan
programme.desc: The popularity of New Zealand's mascot, Pabu-chan, grows at the Sapporo Snow Festival, and then he gets a chance to hit the big time. Rhys also travels to the Okinawa Islands in search of the beautiful and fleeting cherry blossoms.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Portugal"
programme.desc: Rodney is in Porto, Portugal. And although he's not yet a huge fan of Portuguese food, he's here to see if this seaside city can inspire him to change his mind. After watching the fishermen haul in their catch, Rodney cooks up lunch for one of the fishermen and his wife.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S4 - "Treetops"
programme.desc: Suhail and Niki have busy schedules. He’s a marketing director and she’s a doctor so she’s often on call for a hospital downtown. Can they find a place that can help relieve stress, but also be close enough to downtown for those urgent calls?

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S4 - "Above and Beyond"
programme.desc: Wendy and Daniel are looking to downsize after their kids have moved out, but still want an elegant home. She’s a physical therapist and she’s a business analyst. They want something that can help them relax at the end of the day.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S4 - "Energized"
programme.desc: Danielle is helping quite a pair, Joseph is a chiropractor and Nadia is an aerospace engineer. They’re looking for a home to start a family. Not only that, they want space to host their extended family. Will it be as difficult as rocket science?

programme.desc: We travel to the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Canadian Rocky Mountains for their stunning natural beauty, historical castles, and epic adventures. This is a destination where protecting its natural resources comes before anything else.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Rollercoaster Ride"

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "The City and the Country"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The City and the Country

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Barcelona & London"
programme.desc: If you’re a budding architect or simply an admirer of beautiful buildings this episode takes in some of best in Europe from London and Barcelona.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Busiest Time of the Year

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "New South Wales, Budapest"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 New South Wales, Budapest

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S4 - "Fabulous"
programme.desc: Janelle and Manuel are young professionals looking for more space. With one child tagging along on the tour already, they need a place for their growing family. They might need to do some renovations, but they want everything to be perfect.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S4 - "Fun House"
programme.desc: These two business owners Joseph and Heather work hard and want to play hard! They’re looking for a place to entertain guests, and Daryl’s got some amazing homes to show them.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S6 - "Milwaukee"

programme.title: Travel in Style S3 - "Lake Como & Stockholm"

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over...

programme.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programme.title: Forged in Legend: A Glimpse of Longquan Blades
programme.desc: Longquan swords, legendary blades from China, embody centuries of masterful craftsmanship. Forged with unique folding techniques and a distinctive star-patterned finish, these swords are renowned for their sharpness, resilience, and artistic value. Discover the rich history and cultural significance of these revered symbols of Chinese heritage.

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup - a local favourite, every bite tells the story of the city's laid-back charm and beauty. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou
programme.desc: Welcome to Haikou, also known as the Coconut City! Join Tianran He in experiencing the unique culinary culture and urban character of this tropical paradise. From light and sweet coconut chicken hotpot to refreshing herbal desserts and spicy rice soup - a local favourite, every bite tells the story of the city's laid-back charm and beauty. We'll explore everything from Haikou's winding alleys and mangrove forests, to the culture of its southeast Asian diaspora, so come and discover this magical destination with us.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Horses in art
programme.desc: 2026 is the Year of the Horse, but what does the animal represent in Chinese culture? Join us as we follow the horse through art: How a sculptor captures the horse's beauty? A Peking Opera performer reveals how to become horse and rider on stage. Xu Beihong's iconic ink paintings and the spirit they inspired across a nation. Ethnic Mongolian dance, expressing the freedom and joy of riding This Year of the Horse: be bold. Pick up the reins, find your herd and charge ahead.

programme.title: Tasting the Lifestyle of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode uncovers Chongqing's lifestyle, where hot pot is more than food but a city symbol intertwined with climate and history. Tracing its roots at a hot pot museum and experiencing mountain restaurants, we see its evolution from dockworkers' fare to a trendy lifestyle. Exploring graffiti streets, old teahouses and Hongyadong, we find Chongqing balances vibrancy and leisure amid modern development.

programme.title: Discovering the Ancient Grottoes of Chongqing
programme.desc: The third episode of the Chongqing Series, Humanistic Chongqing, focuses on the Dazu Stone Carvings in Chongqing. In 1999, the Dazu Stone Carvings were inscribed on the World Cultural Heritage List. As an outstanding representative of China's late grotto carving art, they integrate the essence of Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism in their content, fully embodying the beauty of cultural integration. programme.title: Saddling up for new adventures with bold neon and traditional ink
programme.desc: This Lunar New Year, horses are set to steal the show as the Chinese zodiac migrates over to a new animal. But for one Beijing artist, born under this very sign, painting these trusty steeds is more than just a tradition – it’s an expression of freedom. Her work fuses explosive neon colors with bold ink lines. So, what drives her to create these galloping beasts?

programme.desc: As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN’s Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, “Fun Guide to China”. programme.title: YEAR OF THE HORSE Why horses in British and Chinese art still speak to the Year of the Horse today
programme.desc: What does an iconic British racehorse have in common with Chinese ink paintings? Quite a lot, actually. This Year of the Horse, we’re looking at how artists across cultures have captured freedom, movement, and spirit.

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down...

programme.title: Fun Guide to China: Hainan 2
programme.desc: In this episode host Tianran He continues his adventure across Hainan. This time, the road trip begins in Dongfang, where Tianran tucks into roast suckling pig by day and, by night, attends grassroots basketball games that rival NBA games in atmosphere. In the mountains of Wuzhishan, Tianran explores a lush jungle with forest rangers, before stepping back in time to 1988 for a retro-chic disco night. In Lingshui, the journey moves offshore as Tianran enjoys a seafood feast on a floating fishing platform, then heads back to shore to visit a contemporary art museum by the pier. After reaching Sanya in the south, he joins scuba divers on a mission to restore coral reefs, before winding down...

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: Awakening Lion-1
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: My Little Cricket Fighter
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore a time-honored form of entertainment in China that has existed for thousands of years – cricket fighting. Music, Chinese chess, calligraphy and painting, and raising flowers, birds, fish and insects are known as the Eight Traditional Pastimes of the Chinese people. Raising insects may be the last on the list, but it is a pastime unique to China. Though these small creatures are tiny, the culture surrounding them has been nurtured by the Chinese people over thousands of years, embodying the unique cultural psychology, folk customs and aesthetic values of the Chinese nation.

programme.title: Awakening Lion-1
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Awakening Lion-1
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.desc: In this instalment, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lifts the veil on the products people buy. Almost everything we buy has a direct impact on our environment. We head to Japan to talk about the impact of new technologies, then to the Republic of Congo in Bukavu for the coltan harvest. How does our total consumption affect the environment? What permanent brands are we imposing on our planet? How can we differentiate between useful and useless purchases?

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 2
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 2
programme.desc: Above all, these reports are an opportunity for Yann Arthus-Bertrand to take stock of the planet and denounce certain human behaviors that are at the root of dramatic, even irreversible, environmental and climatic degradation. Off to Tokyo, then Kenya, to an animal sanctuary. Then on to Mount Fuji to learn how to live there, and all the plastic that clogs up the seas. Reports will focus on everyday products, chosen for their destructive production practices for both people and the environment.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The taste of bread
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The taste of bread
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 4 - Nature’s Heroes: Bangladesh - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Nature’s Heroes: Bangladesh - Part 1
programme.desc: With Bangladesh as a running thread, Yann Arthus-Bertrand meets several people who have changed their lives to dedicate themselves to a major project. In Bangladesh, Yves and Runa Marre have created the Friendship Foundation. Among other things, they’ve created a floating hospital installed on an old barge bought in France. Julie Andersen, an ex-advertising executive from New York has come to South Africa to defend sharks with her Shark Angels Foundation. In North India, Kartik Satyanarayan is helping to stop the dreadful exploitation of the lippus bears (dancing bears). He’s created Wildlife SOS, a preserve to rehabilitate the bears that have been rescued and to give work to the men of...

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 USA: The end of oil - Part 1
programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll...

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - A la carte grills
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 A la carte grills
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S08 : E16 SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 16, Turkey Part 1
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E01 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 1 - Finland
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E02 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 2 - Serbia
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E03 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E04 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 4 - Holland
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E05 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 5 - Holland 2023
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E06 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 6 - World's Strongest Latino
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E07 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 7 - Finland World Record Breakers
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E08 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 8 - Portugal
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E09 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 9 - England
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E10 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 10 - World's Strongest Viking
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E14 SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 14 - South Africa
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E15 Stage 15 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S09 : E16 Stage 16 - SCL World Finals Bosnia
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

Nandini is shocked to see Shekhar’s regressive and patriarchal family. Soon, the couple gets caught up in a feudal war between two gangs. While trying to resolve the feud, Shekhar gets killed. Devastated, Nandini tries to flee with Raja, but Shekhar's father Narasimha imprisons them. With danger looming everywhere, will Nandini manage to save Raja and herself?

Despite their contrasting personalities and initial conflicts, they fall in love and face numerous challenges together, including family opposition and personal vendettas. The show blends themes of love, family, and ambition with a strong emphasis on culinary arts.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E93 Jodha Akbar S4 E93
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E98 Jodha Akbar S4 E98
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

With points on the line and no room for error, this episode delivers pure Monster Jam intensity from start to finish.
